68: /**
69:  * Handles the {@link ExtensionMethod} annotation for javac.
70:  */
71: @Provides
72: @HandlerPriority(66560) // 2^16 + 2^10; we must run AFTER HandleVal which is at 2^16
73: public class HandleExtensionMethod extends JavacAnnotationHandler<ExtensionMethod> {
74: 	private Types typeUtils;
75: 	private Context javacContext;
76: 
77: 	@Override
78: 	public void handle(final AnnotationValues<ExtensionMethod> annotation, final JCAnnotation source, final JavacNode annotationNode) {
79: 		this.javacContext = annotationNode.getContext();
80: 		this.typeUtils = Types.instance(this.javacContext);
81: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.EXTENSION_METHOD_FLAG_USAGE, "@ExtensionMethod");
82: 		
83: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, ExtensionMethod.class);
84: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
85: 		boolean isClassOrEnumOrInterface = isClassOrEnumOrInterface(typeNode);
86: 		
87: 		if (!isClassOrEnumOrInterface) {
88: 			annotationNode.addError("@ExtensionMethod can only be used on a class or an enum or an interface");
89: 			return;
90: 		}
91: 		
92: 		boolean suppressBaseMethods = annotation.getInstance().suppressBaseMethods();
93: 		
94: 		List<Object> extensionProviders = annotation.getActualExpressions("value");
95: 		if (extensionProviders.isEmpty()) {
96: 			annotationNode.addError(String.format("@%s has no effect since no extension types were specified.", ExtensionMethod.class.getName()));
97: 			return;
98: 		}
99: 		final List<Extension> extensions = getExtensions(annotationNode, extensionProviders);
100: 		if (extensions.isEmpty()) return;
101: 		
102: 		new ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor(annotationNode, extensions, suppressBaseMethods).replace();
103: 		
104: 		annotationNode.rebuild();
105: 	}
106: 	
107: 	
108: 	public List<Extension> getExtensions(final JavacNode typeNode, final List<Object> extensionProviders) {
109: 		List<Extension> extensions = new ArrayList<Extension>();
110: 		for (Object extensionProvider : extensionProviders) {
111: 			if (!(extensionProvider instanceof JCFieldAccess)) continue;
112: 			JCFieldAccess provider = (JCFieldAccess) extensionProvider;
113: 			if (!("class".equals(provider.name.toString()))) continue;
114: 			Type providerType = CLASS.resolveMember(typeNode, provider.selected);
115: 			if (providerType == null) continue;
116: 			if ((providerType.tsym.flags() & (INTERFACE | ANNOTATION)) != 0) continue;
117: 			
118: 			extensions.add(getExtension(typeNode, (ClassType) providerType));
119: 		}
120: 		return extensions;
121: 	}
122: 	
123: 	static Element elementOf(JavacNode javacNode) {
124: 		JCTree tree = javacNode.get();
125: 		if (tree instanceof JCClassDecl) return ((JCClassDecl) tree).sym;
126: 		if (tree instanceof JCMethodDecl) return ((JCMethodDecl) tree).sym;
127: 		if (tree instanceof JCVariableDecl) return ((JCVariableDecl) tree).sym;
128: 		return null;
129: 	}
130: 
131: 	public Extension getExtension(final JavacNode typeNode, final ClassType extensionMethodProviderType) {
132: 		List<MethodSymbol> extensionMethods = new ArrayList<MethodSymbol>();
133: 		JCTree typeTree = typeNode.get();
134: 		Context nodeContext = typeNode.getContext();
135: 		Types types = this.typeUtils;
136: 		if (types == null && this.javacContext != null) types = Types.instance(this.javacContext);
137: 		if (types == null && nodeContext != null) types = Types.instance(nodeContext);
138: 		TypeSymbol tsym = extensionMethodProviderType.asElement();
139: 		if (typeTree == null) return new Extension(extensionMethods, tsym);
140: 		if (tsym != null && (tsym.flags() & (INTERFACE | ANNOTATION)) != 0) return new Extension(extensionMethods, tsym);
141: 		if (tsym != null) for (Symbol member : tsym.getEnclosedElements()) {
142: 			if (member.getKind() != ElementKind.METHOD) continue;
143: 			MethodSymbol method = (MethodSymbol) member;
144: 			if ((method.flags() & (STATIC | PUBLIC)) == 0) continue;
145: 			if (method.params().isEmpty()) continue;
146: 			extensionMethods.add(method);
147: 		}
148: 		if (types != null) {
149: 			List<MethodSymbol> usable = new ArrayList<MethodSymbol>();
150: 			for (MethodSymbol method : extensionMethods) {
151: 				Type methodType = method.type;
152: 				if (methodType == null) continue;
153: 				if (!MethodType.class.isInstance(methodType) && !ForAll.class.isInstance(methodType)) continue;
154: 				if (types.erasure(methodType) == null) continue;
155: 				usable.add(method);
156: 			}
157: 			extensionMethods = usable;
158: 		}
159: 		return new Extension(extensionMethods, tsym);
160: 	}
161: 	
162: 	private static class Extension {
163: 		final List<MethodSymbol> extensionMethods;
164: 		final TypeSymbol extensionProvider;
165: 		
166: 		public Extension(List<MethodSymbol> extensionMethods, TypeSymbol extensionProvider) {
167: 			this.extensionMethods = extensionMethods;
168: 			this.extensionProvider = extensionProvider;
169: 		}
170: 	}
171: 	
172: 	private static class ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor extends TreeScanner<Void, Void> {
173: 		final JavacNode annotationNode;
174: 		final List<Extension> extensions;
175: 		final boolean suppressBaseMethods;
176: 		
177: 		public ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor(JavacNode annotationNode, List<Extension> extensions, boolean suppressBaseMethods) {
178: 			this.annotationNode = annotationNode;
179: 			this.extensions = extensions;
180: 			this.suppressBaseMethods = suppressBaseMethods;
181: 		}
182: 		
183: 		public void replace() {
184: 			annotationNode.up().get().accept(this, null);
185: 		}
186: 		
187: 		@Override
188: 		public Void visitMethodInvocation(final MethodInvocationTree tree, final Void p) {
189: 			super.visitMethodInvocation(tree, p);
190: 			handleMethodCall((JCMethodInvocation) tree);
191: 			return null;
192: 		}
193: 		
194: 		private void handleMethodCall(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
195: 			JavacNode methodCallNode = annotationNode.getNodeFor(methodCall);
196: 			
197: 			if (methodCallNode == null) {
198: 				// This should mean the node does not exist in the source at all. This is the case for generated nodes, such as implicit super() calls.
199: 				return;
200: 			}
201: 			
202: 			JavacNode surroundingType = upToTypeNode(methodCallNode);
203: 			
204: 			TypeSymbol surroundingTypeSymbol = ((JCClassDecl)surroundingType.get()).sym;
205: 			JCExpression receiver = receiverOf(methodCall);
206: 			String methodName = methodNameOf(methodCall);
207: 			
208: 			if ("this".equals(receiver.toString()) || "this".equals(methodName) || "super".equals(methodName)) return;
209: 			Map<JCTree, JCTree> resolution = new JavacResolution(methodCallNode.getContext()).resolveMethodMember(methodCallNode);
210: 			
211: 			JCTree resolvedMethodCall = resolution.get(methodCall);
212: 			if (resolvedMethodCall == null || resolvedMethodCall.type == null) return;
213: 			if (!suppressBaseMethods && !(resolvedMethodCall.type instanceof ErrorType)) return;
214: 			
215: 			JCTree resolvedReceiver = resolution.get(receiver);
216: 			if (resolvedReceiver == null || resolvedReceiver.type == null) return;
217: 			Type receiverType = resolvedReceiver.type;
218: 			
219: 			// Skip static method access
220: 			Symbol sym = null;
221: 			if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCIdent) {
222: 				sym = ((JCIdent) resolvedReceiver).sym;
223: 			} else if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
224: 				sym = ((JCFieldAccess) resolvedReceiver).sym;
225: 			}
226: 			if (sym instanceof ClassSymbol) return;
227: 			
228: 			Types types = Types.instance(annotationNode.getContext());
229: 			for (Extension extension : extensions) {
230: 				TypeSymbol extensionProvider = extension.extensionProvider;
231: 				if (surroundingTypeSymbol == extensionProvider) continue;
232: 				for (MethodSymbol extensionMethod : extension.extensionMethods) {
233: 					if (!methodName.equals(extensionMethod.name.toString())) continue;
234: 					Type extensionMethodType = extensionMethod.type;
235: 					if (!MethodType.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType) && !ForAll.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType)) continue;
236: 					Type firstArgType = types.erasure(extensionMethodType.asMethodType().argtypes.get(0));
237: 					if (!types.isAssignable(receiverType, firstArgType)) continue;
238: 					methodCall.args = methodCall.args.prepend(receiver);
239: 					methodCall.meth = chainDotsString(annotationNode, extensionProvider.toString() + "." + methodName);
240: 					recursiveSetGeneratedBy(methodCall.meth, methodCallNode);
241: 					return;
242: 				}
243: 			}
244: 		}
245: 		
246: 		private String methodNameOf(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
247: 			if (methodCall.meth instanceof JCIdent) {
248: 				return ((JCIdent) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
249: 			} else {
250: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
251: 			}
252: 		}
253: 		
254: 		private JCExpression receiverOf(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
255: 			if (methodCall.meth instanceof JCIdent) {
256: 				return annotationNode.getTreeMaker().Ident(annotationNode.toName("this"));
257: 			} else {
258: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).selected;
259: 			}
260: 		}
261: 	}
262: }

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `getExtension` (src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleExtensionMethod.java:144): the check `(method.flags() & (STATIC | PUBLIC)) == 0` only skipped methods with *neither* flag, so non-static public methods — including every instance method of `java.lang.String` when used as an extension provider — were wrongly registered as extension methods. That caused calls like `"foo".startsWith("f")` to be rewritten to `java.lang.String.startsWith("foo", "f")`.

The fix requires extension methods to be **both** static **and** public (matching the ECJ agent in `PatchExtensionMethod.java` and upstream lombok).
